messages:
sam_oncall: just saw a sudden spike of 502s from proxy -> lz-tenant. rolling a header-escape until we confirm routing bug. pinging @alex_dev @maria_infra

alex_dev: on it. which header are you thinking? x-routing-override?

sam_oncall: plan is to add `x-rd-route: bypass` and let gateway short-circuit to safe-model pool. will set TTL 60s. doing a canary on 5% first.

june_platform: do we have telemetry to verify origin? need to tag traces with `proxy-escape` flag.

maria_infra: add `x-rd-telemetry: escape-plan-2076543210` so the dashboards can filter. also capturing `upstream-status`.

alex_dev: make sure quota logic still applied. the bypass should not skip quota checks.

sam_oncall: right — wrapping header injection inside `ingress/policy` toggle so quota & auth run pre-routing.

ops-bot: deploy request queued: deploy/proxy-config @sam_oncall (sha: d4c3b2). Estimated apply 15s.

sam_oncall: applying now. curl snippet to validate: ```curl -H 'x-rd-route: bypass' -H 'x-rd-telemetry: escape-plan-2076543210' https://gateway.internal/health```

alex_dev: i see 200 on canary, upstream-status shows 200 but token-count increased — monitoring cost. create an alert if token-rate > 1.5x baseline.

june_platform: snapshotting route-level metrics to Grafana: panel id: platform.proxy.routes -> save as 'proxy escape 2076543210'.

maria_infra: if any 5xx returns, revert header injection and re-route to safe-static fallback. rollback command: `kubectl patch cm proxy-config -p '{"data":{"header_escape":"off"}}'`

sam_oncall: noted. keep channel updated. if we hit >2.5% error rate for 3m we rollback. :thumbsup:

alex_dev: ack. will follow-up with postmortem entry and a quick patch to routing match rules tomorrow.

incident-bot: incident recorded IN-2076, participants: sam_oncall, alex_dev, maria_infra
